description: Ask the language server for the definition, references, implementation, type, callers, callees or hover of a declaration. Name it with symbol (one call, resolved to its declaration) or target it with symbol_locator {path, name_path}. Needs an attached language server (language_server_status); for a plain text search use search.

plan_id.description: Plan whose prepared revision to answer about, as an alternative to naming the revision.

plan_revision.description: Expected plan revision; a preparation replaced since is refused rather than answered.

response_format.description: both preserves text and structured payloads; text omits their duplicate structured copy; structured returns structured data with a short text receipt. Overrides the response_mode transport default.

response_mode.description: compact returns one text payload by default, concise edit receipts, and read source windows of 64 KiB unless max_bytes is supplied. full preserves the existing response. Refusal and verification information is retained.

revision.description: Prepared revision (prep_...) to answer about; omit, or pass current, for the canonical workspace.

root.description: Project root; opens or reuses its workspace when workspace_id is omitted.

symbol.description: Declaration name; resolved to its one declaration so no target is needed.

after_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bounded following anchor.

before_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bounded preceding anchor.

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact selected bytes.

name_path.description: Declaration name path: Name, Parent/Name, Parent.Name, Parent::Name or, for Go methods, (*Parent).Name; all are normalised to Parent/Name.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID from workspace_open; or omit it and pass root.

name: navigate
